audio_text_cebuano: Sikat. Kana nga mang-aawit kay sikat.
context_paragraph: That singer is famous. Cleaning the room is my responsibility. I persuade my friend to help me.

explanation_text: A job or task that you must do.
To make someone agree to do something.
